text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mmm, that was delicious. Nothing beats bananas when it comes to caloric efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Well, well! If it isn't the Banana Fiend! Haha! Looks like she just had another one.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Banana Fiend"? I hope they're not talking about—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Hey, Banana Fiend! Getting that potassium fix of yours?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: E-excuse you! I'm not even sure I know you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Banana Fiend… How dare they call me that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So that's what happened in my dream…
choice_data_list: You like bananas so much, you dream about them?
You like bananas so much, you dream about them?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: N-no! It may be true that I eat a large number of bananas, but it's not only because of taste!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: They provide energy to the brain, are portable, and their sweetness helps reduce fatigue! It's only logical that I would—

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text: Welcome! We're having a sale on bananas today! Come get your fill!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: They're having a banana sale?!
Stomach growls…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Is this really my fate? Can I truly not escape… the temptation?!
choice_data_list: C'mon, snap out of it, Banana Fiend.
C'mon, snap out of it, Banana Fiend.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Is this really my fate? Can I truly not escape… the temptation?!
choice_data_list: C'mon, snap out of it, Banana Fiend.
C'mon, snap out of it, Banana Fiend.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I thought I told you to quit calling me that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry about that… And thank you. I nearly succumbed to it…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's leave before my nightmare becomes a reality.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why, it all makes sense now!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My stomach's growling isn't an indication of my gluttony but a signal from my brain to supplement my body's nutritional deficiencies!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In that case, I have no choice but to eat up!
She eats like a true champion. Seeing her devour that many bananas almost makes me want to call her "Banana Fiend" too.
